title: Recognize Capability and Connect It to Value

blocks.title: Use the same project and verified work
blocks.text: Inventory ten supported capabilities. Keep incomplete evidence pending; do not invent an achievement to reach ten. Use privacy-safe references and label fictional, sanitized or recreated examples accurately.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: A proposal-review exercise contains a scope note, normal fictional input, an input missing a delivery date, first and revised drafts, a review checklist and a corrected walkthrough. The first draft invents a delivery date. A human identifies the unsupported claim and revises the instruction. In the revised walkthrough, the missing date remains a question for review. These are supplied teaching observations, not learner results. No real customer sale, measured time saving or sending permission is established.
